notes.title: Demo Update & Bug Fixing _ Sep 10 2025
Demo Update & Bugs Fixing _ Aug 4 2025
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions.
This update includes the following fixes:

Fixed a bug where NPC backpack contents would become scrambled.

Fixed a bug where the Explosive Doll could detonate inside the player's backpack under certain conditions.

Fixed a bug where the Strong Bone Shard would occasionally reduce HP.

Fixed a bug where items accidentally clicked during a canceled trade would disappear.

Fixed a bug where Invisibility Potions could revive fallen adventurers.

Fixed a bug where players could wall-jump into the second area using an unintended method.

Fixed a bug with the Blind Skeleton's sleep animation.

We'll continue working to fix other bugs—thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Demo Update and Bugs Fixing _ Jul 30 2025
notes.notes:
Thank you to all players for your feedback and suggestions.
This update does not include major new content. The focus was on bug fixes, UI improvements, and numerical adjustments. Key changes are as follows:Bug Fixes:
● Fixed a bug where the map failed to display after reaching Goldville.

● Fixed occasional crashes related to Collections and Charms.

● Fixed the unusable Silent Potion bug.

● Fixed overlapping effects for Bone Shards.

● Fixed Bone Shards not shattering upon player death.

● Fixed the unusable Grease item during trades.

● Fixed accidental item dragging when clicking items.

● Fixed the Biting Chest failing to kill targets.

● Fixed interface freezes when opening inventory while dying.

● Fixed incorrect bonus values for Prismatic Gems.

● Fixed various other UI-related bugs.
Numerical Adjustments:
● Rebalanced shop upgrade values.

● Increased pre-order multipliers.

● Boosted quest multipliers for Aliya’s missions.

● Shops no longer automatically gain more customers upon upgrades (a franchise system will be introduced later to assist with sales).
System & UI:
● Added automatic nightly saves (game now saves at the start of both morning and evening each day).

● Added volume adjustment and exit buttons.

● Optimized select UI layouts for clarity and readability.
